senses.gloss:
f. (-ङ्गा)
The river Ganges, or its personification as a goddess.
E.
गम to go, Uṇādi affix गन्, or गां the accusative of गो the earth, and ग who goes, form irr.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Belonging or relating to the river Ganges.
m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA.
2 A name of BHĪṢMA.
E.
गङ्गा the GAṄGĀ, अण् aff.

f. (-का)
The river Ganges.
E.
कन् added to the preceding; also read गङ्गका.

n. (-त्रं)
The river Ganges, and two Kos on either of its banks.
E.
गङ्गा, and क्षेत्र holy place; all dying within such limits going to heaven, whatever their crimes.

f. (-ल्ली)
The black headed gull, (Larus ridibundus.)
E.
गङ्गा the Ganges, and चिल्ली a kite, considered by the Hindus as a species of that bird; the Gangetic kite.

m. (-जः)
1 A name of BHĪṢMA.
2 A name of the deity KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
गङ्गा the river goddess, and ज born; the son of GAṄGĀ.

n. (-लं)
The water of the Gaṅgā.
E.
गङ्गा, and जल water.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Going in or to the Ganges.
m. (-यः)
A shrimp or prawn; also गलाविल.
E.
गङ्गा the river, and अट् to go, अच् affix, गङ्गाट, and ढक् added.

m. (-यः)
A shrimp or prawn.
E.
गङ्गा, अट to go, and ढक् affix; also गङ्गाटेय, and गाङ्काट, &c.

n. (-रः)
The place where the Gaṅgā enters the plains; also Haridvār.
E.
गङ्गा, and द्वार gate.

m. (-रं)
The bank of the Gaṅgā.
E.
गङ्गा, and तीर a bank.

m. (-रः)
1 An epithet of ŚIVA.
2 The ocean.
E.
गङ्गा the Ganges, and धर who possesses or receives; according to the legend, the Ganges in its descent first alighted on the head of ŚIVA, and continued for some period entangled in his hair.

n. (-रं)
The bank of the Ganges.
E.
गङ्गा and पार the bank.

m. (-त्रः)
1 BHĪṢMA.
2 A man of a mixed and vile caste, employed to remove dead bodies.
3 A Brahman who conducts the ceremonies of pilgrimage at some places on the Ganges, especially at Benares,
E.
गङ्गा, and पुत्र a son.

n. (-ध्यं)
The bed or stream of the Ganges.
E.
गङ्गा, and मध्य centre.

n. (-म्बु)
1 Pure rain water, such as falls in Aśvin.
2 Ganges water.
E.
गङ्गा, and अम्बु water.

f. (-त्रा)
1 Pilgrimage to the Gaṅgā.
2 Carrying a sick person to the river side to die there.
E.
गङ्गा, and यात्रा going.

m. (-तः)
1 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA.
2 A name of the hero BHĪṢMA: see गङ्गाज.
E.
गङ्गा, and सुत a son; the son of GAṄGĀ.

f. (-का)
The Ganges.
E.
गङ्गा, and कन् affix fem. form; also गङ्गका, and गङ्गाका.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Become as the Ganges, as sacred, &c.
E.
मङ्गा, and भूत become, च्चि augment.

m. (-टः)
A prawn or shrimp.
E.
गाङ्ग relating to the Ganges, and अट what goes, form irr.; also गाङ्गाट or with कन् affix गाङ्गटक.

f. (-निः)
1 A name of BHĪṢMA.
2 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
गङ्गा the personified river, (as the wife of ŚANTANU, in the first instance, and mother of the hero; and in the second, as the receiver of KĀRTTIKEYA the son of ŚIVA, from AGNI, the god of fire,) and फिञ् patronymic aff.

m. (-यः)
1 BHĪṢMA.
2 KĀRTTIKEYA: see the preceding.
3 The Hilsa or Illias fish, (Clupanodon ilisha, HAM.)
n. (-यं)
1 Gold.
2 A grass: see कशेरु.
3 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
E.
गङ्गा the Ganges, ढक् affix of descent, &c.

f. (-की)
A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides, but it is variously described.)
E.
गाङ्ग Ganges water, ईर to go or grow, उकन् aff.

f. (-ष्ठी)
A plant, (Guilandina bonducella.)

n. (-घं)
The current of the Ganges.
E.
गाङ्ग Gangetic, and ओघ heap.
